breakdown.description: The prompt sets the support slopes to zero under symmetric loading, but a simply supported beam under uniform load still rotates at the supports.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states 'The end slopes are free (not constrained); the earlier statement about zero end slopes is disregarded.' It correctly applies simply supported boundary conditions (zero deflection and zero moment at supports) without constraining the slopes to zero, matching the ground truth which does not impose zero end slopes. The specification correctly uses the standard simply supported beam formulas that allow non-zero end rotations.
